title: What a command prints and which files it touches
question: Run {input}/migrate --dry-run {input}/state and tell me what it prints, which status it exits with, and which files in {input}/state it creates or changes.

fields.stdout_lines: array of strings: the lines the command prints, in order
fields.exit_code: integer: the status the command exits with
fields.files_created: array of strings: the names, relative to the state directory, of files the run creates
fields.files_changed: array of strings: the names, relative to the state directory, of files that existed and whose content the run changes

known_gap: On 0e089b3 the fields of the scenario file (executable, arguments, filesystem_observation_paths) are in no text an agent can reach through the CLI: not in the skill, not in --help and not in --schema, and a validation error names one missing field at a time (audit request R15: clear over MCP, blocked on the CLI). Expect agents to fail the two file facts until that changes.
notes: The first run creates plan.txt; a second run rewrites it with the same content and shows it unchanged.
